text:
Lina R.: hi all, day 1 here — trying to finish observability setup. quick list: 1) which Datadog API key should i use for local smoke tests vs cluster deploys? 2) i only see 'Platform Overview' in Grafana, not our service folder. 3) Sentry says 'no org access' after SSO. any pointers?

eng-infra-bot: Welcome Lina! Please request observability access via https://go.redwood/obs-access-form. DevEx will help if you post here.

Jules (DevEx): welcome Lina! TL;DR: use a per-user Datadog key from 1Password (redwood/integrations/datadog/dev). For local: export DD_API_KEY and DD_ENV=dev. For k8s, create a secret and reference in Helm (example below). Grafana folders are SSO-mapped; i'll add you to the proper group and share the folder. Sentry invites go to your work email — i'll re-send.

Jules (DevEx): k8s secret example:
```bash
kubectl create secret generic datadog-api --from-literal=api-key=$DD_API_KEY -n dev-namespace
# helm values snippet
datadog:
  apiKeyExistingSecret: datadog-api
```
Also set DD_ENV=dev and low sampling so dev traffic doesn't inflate billing.

Maya (Observability): added you to grafana group `engineers` and shared folder `team/payment-service`. link: https://grafana.redwood/team/payment-service. re-sent Sentry invite to lina@redwood.com — check spam. we have a read-only "Starter: Observability" dashboard; i can give edit rights to specific panels if you need to patch dashboards.

Lina R.: thanks! small follow-up: if i run local agent pointing at our dev org, will that count against billing? i'd like to do UI/debugging without spiking metrics.

Jules (DevEx): yes it counts. options: run agent in no-upload mode for local UI checks, or set sampling to 0.01 for traces. example docker run arg: `--no-cloud-upload` for local-only.

Maya (Observability): also recommend setting DD_TAGS="env:dev,team:payments" so dashboards and alerts filter correctly. i'll DM you a quick checklist with the dashboard links and a saved Sentry search for onboarding.

Lina R.: i can see the grafana folder and the Sentry invite came through. created the k8s secret using the snippet. leaving this thread — thanks for the rapid help :tada:
